items.company: UK DTC creative agency (Upwork client, name not shown)
items.subject: Creative Strategist — One Month Paid Engagement, DTC Health & Wellness
items.body:
You're adding a strategy layer for a DTC health & wellness brand: distinct angles, briefs your editors can produce without questions, and nothing that trips Meta's health rules.

How I'd run month one: customer research first (reviews, Reddit, competitor ads in the Ad Library), then 3 angles that are genuinely different strategies, e.g. a moment-of-use angle, an objection-killer and a "what I tried before" angle. Each gets 3 hooks, a UGC script and a VO/B-roll brief with shot list, on-screen text, pacing and CTA. First-person framing only, no implied outcomes, no before/after.

I've built static and script concepts for DTC brands in health/wellness and personal care. More at theprofitscript.com.

One question: will I see the brand's current winners and hold-rate data from week one, or start from research only?

Happy to send 3 hook ideas for the brand before we start.

Carl

items.subject: Contract Creative Strategist
items.body:
10–12 briefs a week across 10 DTC brands, each one a real new angle, not a reskin of last week's winner.

How I'd work: a short research base per brand first (reviews, Reddit, Ad Library), then briefs that rotate angle types (objection, moment-of-use, mechanism, comparison), each with hooks, primary text and headlines, plus a weekly note on what's fatiguing and what I'd test next.

Skincare concept I'd test next week: a native notes-app static, "how I'm starting my serum (slowly)", for an actives product. In public reviews the most common reason people quit is irritation in the first weeks, so the ad sells the routine before the product.

I've built static and script concepts for DTC brands in health/wellness and personal care. Samples at theprofitscript.com.

Question: do briefs go straight into your workflow tool, or as docs your team ports in?

Happy to send 3 hook ideas for one of your brands first.

Carl

items.company: US perimenopause haircare brand (pre-launch, name not shown)
items.subject: Creative Designer for Paid Social + Google Search & Display Ads
items.body:
A founder-led perimenopause haircare launch with no product photos yet, three pillars (community, pre-order kit, podcast) and first-person-only copy rules. Clear brief.

How I'd approach it: start from how women in this season describe their hair in their own words, then build type-led and founder-photo statics per pillar in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16, with mockups always labelled as mockups.

Q2, holiday static for The Mary: founder photo, headline "The gift I wish someone had told me about.", label art on a wash-day towel, "Pre-order · ships Dec 15".
Q3: "Perimenopause Hair Care Kit" / "Wash-Day Kit For Midlife Hair" / "Pre-Order: Ships Dec 15".

I've built static and script concepts for DTC brands in health/wellness and personal care: theprofitscript.com.

Question: should the first batch test all three pillars in parallel, or community first to build the audience?

Happy to send 3 hook ideas per pillar before we start.

Carl
